issues.title: File attachment/upload button missing from input toolbar
issues.description: The input toolbar shows only: settings gear icon, info icon, git diff stats (+757 -1129), and a send/voice button. There is no paperclip or attachment icon for file uploads. This means users cannot attach files to messages from the UI. Both desktop and mobile viewports confirmed.
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to http://localhost:8097
Authenticate via localStorage injection
Open any session by clicking it in the sidebar
Look at the input toolbar at the bottom of the chat
Observe: no attachment/upload button is present

issues.title: LaTeX equations render as raw text instead of mathematical notation
issues.description: When Claude responds with inline LaTeX using $...$ delimiters (e.g., $E = mc^2$), the app renders the raw dollar-sign-wrapped text string literally in the chat bubble. The mathematical notation is not typeset. The text shows as '$E = mc^2$' instead of a rendered equation.
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to http://localhost:8097 and authenticate
Open an active online session
Send a message: 'Please write a LaTeX equation like E=mc^2 using $ delimiters'
Wait for Claude's response
Observe: $E = mc^2$ appears as raw text, not as typeset mathematical notation

issues.title: Enter key in input field navigates away from session instead of sending message
issues.description: When typing a message in the session input field and pressing the Enter key, the app navigates to a different session URL (session 2) instead of sending the message. The typed message text remains in the input field (not sent). The expected behavior is: Enter key sends the message. This is a critical usability regression that breaks the most natural keyboard-based message sending flow.
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to http://localhost:8097 and authenticate
Open a session (e.g., /session/cmnixda5w00lxnz15qf7wl3av)
Click on the text input field at the bottom
Type any message text
Press Enter key
Observe: browser navigates to a different URL instead of sending the message

issues.title: Send button triggers microphone permission dialog when input is empty
issues.description: When the text input field is empty and the user clicks the send/voice button, a 'Microphone Access Required' native browser dialog appears asking for microphone permission. There is no visual indicator that the button changes function when the input is empty. A first-time user would expect clicking 'send' with empty input to do nothing or show a tooltip, not a permission dialog. A console error was logged: 'Web microphone permission denied: {}'.
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to http://localhost:8097 and authenticate
Open any session
Ensure the text input field is empty
Click the send button (right side of toolbar)
Observe: browser microphone permission dialog appears

issues.title: Session titles show as 'root' instead of actual session titles in sidebar
issues.description: Both sessions in the sidebar are labeled 'root' instead of their actual titles. The PM also observed this. Real session titles (if set) do not appear to be displayed. This makes it impossible to distinguish between sessions at a glance when a user has multiple sessions.
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to http://localhost:8097 and authenticate
Look at the sidebar session list
Observe: all sessions are labeled 'root' instead of descriptive session titles

issues.title: Navigating to session 2 URL consistently redirects to wrong page
issues.description: Directly navigating to /session/cmnixd68800jxnz15eaw8449j via URL bar or programmatic navigation caused the browser to redirect to session 1 or the Settings page on multiple attempts. The session 2 content was only accessible once via a sidebar click. This makes deep-linking to session 2 unreliable.
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to http://localhost:8097 and authenticate
In the browser address bar, type or navigate to /session/cmnixd68800jxnz15eaw8449j
Observe: page redirects to Settings or session 1 instead of loading session 2

issues.title: Tool call detail view back button sometimes navigates to wrong page
issues.description: After clicking a tool call block to open the detail view, pressing the back arrow in the detail view header navigated to Inbox or Settings instead of returning to the parent session. This happened on multiple attempts. The back navigation is unreliable when the app has complex routing state.
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to http://localhost:8097 and authenticate
Open session /session/cmnixda5w00lxnz15qf7wl3av
Click on a tool call block (e.g., 'Read claudecodeui service file')
Verify you are on the detail view URL
Click the back arrow button at the top of the detail view
Observe: app may navigate to Inbox or Settings instead of back to the session

issues.title: File download support not present in the app
issues.description: There is no mechanism to download files from chat messages or tool call outputs. No download button, save icon, or right-click context menu for files was observed anywhere in the app. This is a gap compared to Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, and Gemini which all support file downloads.
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to http://localhost:8097 and authenticate
Open any session with tool call outputs
Look for any download or save button on tool call outputs
Look for any download option on message content
Observe: no download functionality is present anywhere

issues.title: wrap, start, stop envelope types not observed in test sessions
issues.description: The test sessions available (cmnixda5w00lxnz15qf7wl3av and cmnixd68800jxnz15eaw8449j) did not contain wrap (skill/command prompt), start (subagent lifecycle), or stop envelope types. Only text, tool-call, service, and AskUserQuestion envelopes were observed and verified. The rendering of wrap/start/stop envelopes could not be verified from available session data.
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to http://localhost:8097 and authenticate
Open session 1 (/session/cmnixda5w00lxnz15qf7wl3av)
Scroll through all messages
Observe: no wrap, start, or stop envelope type messages are present to verify rendering
issues.note: Cannot confirm broken — session data simply lacked these envelope types. Rendering code may be correct but was not exercised.

persona_observations.first-timer: A first-time user would be confused by: (1) all sessions labeled 'root' with no descriptive titles, (2) the send button triggering a microphone dialog when empty input is clicked, (3) Enter key navigating instead of sending messages. The session view content (tool calls, tables) is visually clean and the click-to-detail flow for tool calls is intuitive.
persona_observations.impatient-mobile: Mobile layout (375px) works well overall. Bottom tab navigation is accessible. However, the missing file attachment button means mobile users cannot attach files. The Enter-key-navigates bug would particularly frustrate mobile users using external keyboards. The 'root' session titles make it hard to quickly find the right session.
